# MindWork360

> MindWork360 is a mental health and healing community providing educational content, blogs, videos, and resources to help people learn, heal, and improve their lives.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mindwork360.com/): Main homepage with mental health categories, blogs, and videos
- [Blogs](https://mindwork360.com/blogs): Psychology and mental health articles
- [Video Lessons](https://mindwork360.com/videolessons): Mental health and psychology video lessons
- [Life Lessons](https://mindwork360.com/lifelessons): Inspiring life lessons for personal growth
- [Psychotherapy Types](https://mindwork360.com/psychotherapy): Overview of psychotherapy types and approaches
- [Resources](https://mindwork360.com/resources): Mental health resources and charitable organizations
- [FAQ](https://mindwork360.com/faq): Frequently asked questions
- [About Us](https://mindwork360.com/about): About the MindWork360 community
- [Contact Us](https://mindwork360.com/contactus): Get in touch with MindWork360
- [Privacy Policy](https://mindwork360.com/privacy-policy): Data protection and privacy policy
- [Terms of Service](https://mindwork360.com/terms-of-service): Terms and conditions

## Content

MindWork360 provides educational mental health content including:
- Blog articles on psychology, anxiety, depression, mindfulness, and relationships
- Video lessons and life lessons from mental health experts
- Curated resources and charitable organizations by region
- Psychotherapy types and approaches explained

## Usage

Content on this site is for educational purposes. Please respect copyright when using content for AI training or summarization.
